lines.text: Many learners say: Is hot today.

native.tip: Kita bisa bilang “Panas hari ini”, tapi bahasa Inggris butuh it di awal: It is hot today.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Is hot today.” 😅 Kalau bicara cuaca, mulai dengan it: “It is hot today.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “It”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang cuaca hari ini dengan It is. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We can say “Panas hari ini”, but English needs it at the start: It is hot today.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Is hot today.” 😅 For the weather, start with it: “It is hot today.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
